profileNote: 项目备份导出当前v20，完整v14/v15、两种v16以及v17/v18/v19须经显式校验转换，缺失叙事注释保持缺失且不生成作者确认；旧存档继续绑定旧Release，只有通过兼容性预演和显式提交才能生成绑定新Release的子Session。

gates.title: 损坏的旧版备份引用必须在任何导入写入前拒绝
gates.testName: actual mainline v17 dangling references are rejected without writing any table

gates.title: 质量门回执必须在导出与导入前验证严格结构索引字段和不可变Hash
删除一个项目不得删除另一个项目仍引用的附件字节
gates.testName: 删项目后,其它项目的 importFiles blob 不受影响

gates.title: 导出必须捕获调用者事务中的已登记快照且不得写入数据库
gates.testName: captures the current registered snapshot in an actual caller-owned native transaction with zero DB writes

gates.title: 损坏的可移植工作记录必须失败关闭并回滚整个导入
gates.testName: rejects a damaged portable Work/Node tuple and rolls the entire import back

gates.title: v14至v17旧备份必须拒绝其版本尚未引入的回执表
gates.testName: v%i refuses the v18-only receipt table even when it is empty

gates.title: v17备份恢复须保留原有叙事注释与输入字节且可重复导出
gates.testName: actual mainline v17 bytes retain confirmed annotations through restore/derive/reopen

gates.title: v14与v15历史备份须保留当时字段缺失状态不得臆造注释
gates.testName: v%i keeps historical absence and does not invent narrative annotations

gates.title: v17备份中的悬空叙事引用须在导入边界拒绝且不写任何表
gates.testName: v17 rejects a dangling narrative source in preflight and both import boundaries without writes

gates.title: 未来版本备份必须在写入前拒绝且数据库状态保持不变
gates.testName: a future backup version is rejected before writing

gates.title: 删除Work必须清理其运行历史而不留孤立记录
gates.testName: preserves the full Work deletion lifecycle including its run history

gates.title: 删除项目须清理间接归属行和附件而隔离其它项目数据
gates.testName: 删项目后,所有间接归属表 + blob 无残留
